stop_reason: Completed the preregistered three development rounds, immutable development-only selection and one final paired evaluation. Round three did not improve earlier best checkpoints; no fourth round, test-driven retuning or flight deployment.
findings: Added a separate causal 117-observation v2 environment, PPO trainer and evaluator for fixed original coast targets and irreversible position takeover. Existing v1 sources and 27 checkpoints remain byte-identical.
Trained three CPU PPO lineages through three bounded rounds, sampling 589824 transitions. This is simulator-trained PPO, not fixed-dataset-only offline RL.

Primary ppo_lineage63 was selected on 64 development scenarios before reading final outcomes. Round2 checkpoint has 98304 model timesteps, development loss 7.1891224781806535 and SHA256 90b67bbf9d11af862aa8b315b15ae2eab2ec0712e800b4d77fae4d62ab0dabf5.

All eight methods were paired on 256 new synthetic cases plus 21 separately labeled regressions made from seven previously observed initial states and three synthetic target gaps: 2216 unique metric rows. Evaluation completed once in 49.12 seconds.

Against the development-preselected v1 position adapter on synthetic holdout, mean loss improved from 8.5195 to 6.5767, joint settling from 125/256 to 166/256, and mean maximum rollback from 9.52cm to 6.69cm.
The intended no-pullback stopping behavior is not achieved: only24/256 cases both never reversed and settled,180/256 exceeded0.04m/s reverse speed, and worst rollback increased from40.28cm to47.59cm.

All21 observed-initial/assigned-target regressions eventually settled but all reversed. Their primary loss7.6749 was worse than v1adapter7.1225. They are simulated continuations, not new successful flights.

The attitude-response model comes from frozen measurement-based estimates, but the delayed position PD loop and its randomized ranges remain assumptions. Prior empirical position-capture evaluation passed4/12 and did not identify position dynamics. Current evidence cannot support real-drone deployment.

All13 v2 source hashes,11 v1 source hashes,27 v1 checkpoint hashes and final selected/model/provenance checks passed.104 focused tests passed; original flight environment discovered348 with299passing and49expected optional-dependency skips.

Every case retains full-horizon metrics; only16 diagnostic trajectories with decimated states are archived. Audits distinguish recomputation from recorded extrema and aggregates from unavailable full raw-trajectory reconstruction.

No SSH, vehicle connection, flight, runtime/calibration mutation, commit, push or deployment was performed. Next meaningful work is position-handoff model identification/validation and testing of stopping behavior, not additional tuning on this final test set.

config.goal: Build and execute an independent offline v2 experiment with a fixed coast endpoint, remaining-distance observations and delayed position takeover; preserve failures and report what physical evidence is missing.
config.scope: Local simulator, separate PPO environment/trainer/evaluator, immutable development selection, paired final comparison, source and input provenance only.
